body: @knoopx Thanks for reporting this issue. The maximum update depth error is caused by the same underlying issue as the jittering (as discussed [here](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/6900)). The issue will get fixed in `1.31` by https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7779
